serialized_tail_split_investigation.bound_derivation: Every boundary is FLOP preflush or node/FLOP/end/almost-ready. Node boundaries=0; at most one final nonempty compute node per graph. Subtract all FLOP events and all graph calls, allowing overlaps, for a conservative tail lower bound.
serialized_tail_split_investigation.candidate: Gate only the almost-ready splitting predicate by !serialize_submissions; retain serialized fence waits, final graph flush, node256 and original FLOP cap.
serialized_tail_split_investigation.required_validation: Fresh matched native comparison with complete F32/routes/tokens/bytes exactness, actual boundary/fence/queue-submit counts and positive retirement/ordinary close. This analysis performs no runtime change.

measured_limits: No current-production GPU timestamp/kernel-class timings: the process remainder includes CPU/backend/GPU and cannot be called pure GPU time.
Source syscall wall, consumer metadata, graph caller wall and synchronization timers overlap parent intervals and are not additive partitions.
Read latency quantiles are histogram ranges across prefill/decode/EOS, not exact percentiles or raw NAND latency.
Streaming busy-period occupancy, device queue depth, decode-only physical bytes and source wait were not captured.
Only one30-token prompt with22 generated tokens and three reuse conditions; this is not sustained/different-input qualification.
Exact-prefix counting still ends7 instead of8. No broad answer-quality or correct-answer throughput claim.
